text:
maria_finance: Heads-up — new price-sheet VAR_B rollout goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Small A/B: 10% traffic to VAR_B. We need a clear fallback + invoice guardrails if usage spikes or mapping errors hit billing. @alex_eng @liam_ops @sam_billing please advise.
alex_eng: Thanks. Is the switch done via config flag or route-level? Who owns instant rollback?
liam_ops: It's feature-flag gated. Ops can flip but need a Safe Rollback checklist. Also we should set a transparent fallback to VAR_A if invoice totals deviate >5% over 15m.
sam_billing: Key things from billing side: invoice mappings, tier thresholds, and webhook events. If VAR_B returns different meter ids, invoices will mis-aggregate. Need a preflight diff of meter ids and a simulated invoice run.
jen_cs: Customer comms: any customers grandfathered into old rates need exclusion from VAR_B. We have ~12 enterprise accounts in the grandfathering list. Need confirmation we won't accidentally bill them at VAR_B.
vendor_bob: From vendor export side, I can push a CSV with VAR_B ratecard and meter ids by EOD. Will include mapping to current pricebook.
maria_finance: Action items: 1) @vendor_bob provide CSV 2) @alex_eng confirm flag toggle and fallback logic 3) @liam_ops create rollback playbook + alert 4) @sam_billing run simulated invoice for sample customers incl grandfathering. I'll coordinate cutoff windows.
alex_eng: Flag is a route-level rollout in prod config; toggle in console. Fallback approach: route weight -> 0 for VAR_B, then fallback to VAR_A. I can add a guard in the router to reject requests if meter_id mismatch.
liam_ops: I'll author the rollback playbook and add an alert in PagerDuty if invoice delta >5% within 15m or if failed mapping rate >0.5%. Adding runbook link in doc when ready.
sam_billing: Simulated invoice notes: run at 3x traffic sample to expose edge cases. Will scope to impacted customers + 50 random pay-as-you-go accounts. Expect results in ~2h after vendor CSV. Also: need a migration mapping table.
vendor_bob: CSV uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-vendor-exports/var_b_ratecard_221987.csv. Columns: sku, meter_id, price_cents. LMK if need a different format.
billing-bot: [automated] Invoice queue: 28 pending, avg processing latency 12s. No errors in last 2h.
jen_cs: For grandfathering, I sent a list in GDrive: link https://drive.redwood/drive/1gF... please ensure those account IDs are excluded.
maria_finance: Confirmed — sam, please ensure mapping table includes grandfather_exempt flag. If we detect any invoice on an exempt acct at VAR_B rate, auto-flag and pause billing for manual review.
sam_billing: Will add a `grandfather_exempt` column in the mapping. Also adding a reconciliation script snippet: ```sql
-- sample reconcile
SELECT account_id, SUM(charges) AS total FROM invoices WHERE run_ts BETWEEN x AND y AND meter_id IN ('m-123','m-456') GROUP BY account_id;
```
liam_ops: Suggest adding a temporary canary window: 09:00–10:30 PT with increased monitoring. If any guard trips, rollback immediately.
alex_eng: I'll implement a quick health check endpoint that verifies meter_id parity for the first 200 requests and emits metric `billing.meter_mismatch_rate`.
maria_finance: Sounds good. Final checklist before go: vendor CSV validated, mapping table with grandfather flag, simulated invoice run completed, rollback playbook published, alert thresholds in place. Who owns go/no-go?
jen_cs: CS will hold the go/no-go based on whether grandfathering checks passed and any enterprise concerns are cleared.
liam_ops: Ops will call rollback if alert fires.
sam_billing: Billing will sign off after simulated invoice and mapping sanity checks. ETA for all items: EOD today.
maria_finance: ok — we'll pause the rollout if any item is missing. I'll post final signoff 06:30 PT tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
